verdict.rationale: Ardent's pricing page describes a usage-based model ('Base plan + compute and storage') with a one-time credit, and a community comment mentions a $250/month plan that includes $100/month in credit. That shows a published structure with metered compute and storage. No actual per-unit rates appear in the evidence, and traffic is never mentioned, so a founder cannot yet predict a bill from what is shown. missing for 10: published per-unit compute rates, published per-unit storage rates, any traffic/egress pricing, a cost calculator or worked billing examples, first-party confirmation of base plan price.

support.subject: As a founder, published per-unit pricing for compute, storage, and traffic lets me predict my bill before committing

citations.quote: Base plan + compute and storage. Never pay for idle resources.
